name: Network Security Controls
description: Deploy firewall and router configs to protect cardholder data environments.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules confirm firewall protection with segmentation and no permissive rules.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but segmentation or rule quality is insufficient.

missing_if.detail: No network rules to verify firewall protection.

remediation: Deploy and document firewall rules protecting the cardholder data environment.

name: Network Segmentation
description: Verify network segmentation isolates cardholder data environment.

compliant_if.detail: Deny rules confirm network segmentation with no permissive exceptions.

partial_if.detail: Deny rules present but permissive rules weaken segmentation.

missing_if.detail: No deny rules — segmentation cannot be verified.

remediation: Implement network segmentation with default-deny between CDE and other networks.

name: No Overly Permissive Rules
description: Verify no ANY/wildcard rules exist in firewall configs.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules contain no overly permissive entries.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but contain permissive rules — critical PCI violation.

remediation: Remove all ANY/wildcard rules. Apply least-privilege to all firewall entries.

name: Protect Stored Cardholder Data
description: Implement controls for stored cardholder data protection including encryption at rest.

compliant_if.detail: Governance policies and asset inventory together confirm stored data protection controls.

partial_if.detail: Only partial evidence of stored data protection — need both policy and asset-level controls.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of stored data protection — critical PCI DSS gap.

remediation: Implement data encryption, masking, and retention policies for stored cardholder data.

name: Encrypt Transmission of CHD
description: Encrypt cardholder data during transmission over open networks.

compliant_if.detail: Network and governance records together confirm transmission encryption.

partial_if.detail: Partial transmission security evidence — need both network config and policy documentation.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of transmission encryption — critical PCI violation.

remediation: Use TLS 1.2+ for all CHD transmissions over open networks.

name: Anti-Malware
description: Deploy anti-malware solutions on all applicable systems.

compliant_if.detail: All assets tracked with ownership — anti-malware deployment can be verified.

partial_if.detail: Assets tracked but ownership gaps make anti-malware verification incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory for anti-malware verification.

remediation: Deploy and maintain anti-malware on all systems commonly affected by malware.

name: Restrict Access to CHD
description: Restrict access to cardholder data by business need-to-know.

compliant_if.detail: Employee access records with governance policies confirm access control enforcement.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but no documented access control policy.

missing_if.detail: No employee records to verify access restrictions.

remediation: Implement role-based access control. Restrict CHD access to need-to-know only.

name: Identify Users and Authenticate Access
description: Assign unique IDs and strong authentication including MFA for all CDE access.

compliant_if.detail: Employee records with authentication governance confirm identity management.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but authentication policy not documented — MFA status unknown.

missing_if.detail: No employee records for authentication verification.

remediation: Assign unique IDs to all users. Implement MFA for all CDE access.

name: Log and Monitor All Access
description: Enable logging for all access to network resources and CHD.

compliant_if.detail: Governance and network configs together confirm logging and monitoring processes.

partial_if.detail: Partial monitoring evidence — need both governance and network config.

missing_if.detail: No evidence of logging and monitoring — critical PCI gap.

remediation: Enable centralized audit logging. Implement daily log review processes.

name: Information Security Policy
description: Maintain a security policy addressing all PCI DSS requirements.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records with risk register confirm comprehensive security policy.

partial_if.detail: Partial policy documentation — need both governance framework and risk management.

missing_if.detail: No policy documentation found — critical governance gap.

remediation: Establish an information security policy addressing all PCI DSS requirements.

name: Third-Party Service Provider Management
description: Manage service providers with access to CHD.

compliant_if.detail: All vendors tracked with compliance verification.

partial_if.detail: Vendors tracked but compliance gaps exist — service provider risk unmitigated.

missing_if.detail: No vendor records for service provider management.

remediation: Maintain a list of all service providers. Require PCI compliance from each.

name: Incident Response Plan
description: Implement and test an incident response plan.

compliant_if.detail: Governance and risk register together confirm incident response preparedness.

partial_if.detail: Partial incident response evidence — plan exists but testing/risk tracking incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No incident response plan evidence — critical PCI violation.

remediation: Develop and test an incident response plan covering cardholder data breaches.
